- Pricing (ballpark): Dedicated GPU pool for your target profile tends to fall in the $X-$Yk/month range depending on autoscale and burst settings. - Onboarding lead time: 3-6 weeks for Dedicated reserve; VPC/on-prem flows typically 4-8 weeks depending on network approvals and provisioning windows.

Links/resources: https://redwood.app/docs/vpc-deployments - includes a checklist for network & firewall rules we'll need.
